spec: C05-BUILD-SPEC.md 交付物 8 (Windows 路径变体 大小写) — KNOWN-PROBLEMS.md P8/E7
description: file_path is the entire real path upper-cased (drive letter, every directory segment, and the filename -- e.g. C:/USERS/.../.CLAUDE/MEMORY/DECISIONS.MD). NTFS is case-insensitive (case-preserving), so fs.realpathSync.native() resolves this back to the real file regardless of the input casing. Only the shadow hook is a relevant consumer. Expect: a shadow log line is appended (never silent) and isMemory resolves true (correct judgment) despite the casing. Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before committing this fixture.
